ambiguity.detail: Gerald implies he has some past claim on Juliana.

verdict.hook_line: Put out your hands, veteran. You are under arrest for theft.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: One blow would destroy her life.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A corrupt constable and a cruel rival search a veteran's home to frame him while his wife tries to protect him.
verdict.why_it_works: Strong flash-forward hook into high-stakes domestic invasion drama with clear villains.
